experiment.canary_selection: sealed using tuning/qualification before canary read; synthetic and seed-pretraining exclusion unknown
experiment.comparison_scope: Single sequential run per arm; evaluation budget caps equal but consumed work may differ. No universally-fastest claim.
experiment.qualification: unchanged all gates; no failed candidate promotion

hypotheses: First-positive stopping can waste the remaining declared budget when a larger step would improve more.
Alphabetical momentum history truncation can exclude high-magnitude accepted global coordinates.
Tuning-objective ranking cannot by itself repair training reconstruction when the tuning row is already on the target-return branch.
optimization_goal: Lower unchanged guarded objective per epoch, per actual candidate evaluation, and per wall second, subject to unchanged qualification gates. No global optimality claim.

optional_integration.purpose: Test existing guarded training-reconstruction refinement as a separate integration, not an isolated optimizer speed treatment.

production_default: fixed unchanged; guarded_adaptive preserved; productive_adaptive opt-in

research_context.observation: Adaptive stepsize convergence guarantees require assumptions about objective geometry; the convex guarantee does not certify this discontinuous sparse mixed objective.
Adaptive restart can improve accelerated gradient methods under the studied regimes; our parameter-step carry and guarded search are not that algorithm or its theorem.
